prerequisites: Basic knowledge in Fundamentals of Analysis and Fundamentals of Linear Algebra are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know basic knowledge in statistics, especially regarding statistical key figures, distributions, distribution densities, hypotheses and hypothesis tests.
Students can recognize cross-connections to computer science.
Students can apply mathematical and especially statistical ways of thinking and working to concrete questions, also to technically motivated problems.
Students have mathematical and statistical intuition and can translate it into precise terms and formal justifications.
Students are able to participate in the statistics practical.
Students can discuss statistical content in a structured way within a group.

syllabus_topics: Probability theory, probability measures and spaces

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: The grading is based on 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of these assignments. The examination performance will be either an oral examination (individual) or a written exam.
